title: The echo driver's requests
hints: Write one `complete` helper that sets the status and information (0 on failure) and counts the completion, and make every path end in exactly one call to it.
Check `length > inLength - 8` only after checking `inLength >= 8`; then the subtraction cannot wrap around.
requirements: Every request, good or bad, is completed exactly once, with information 0 on failure.
Access bits in the control codes are enforced.
Lengths, sizes and counts from user mode are checked before use, without overflow.
Statistics and the name round-trip through their IOCTLs.
stretch: Add a pending request: `IOCTL_WAIT_FOR_ECHO` that is marked pending and completed by the next echo, plus cancellation when the handle is closed, so no request is ever left behind at unload.
